title: GM 410: Integrative Manager for Analytics · Master MBA Strategy & Analytics Compendium (Edition 2.0)
subject: Management
description: Definitive postgraduate MBA study guide and interactive examination blueprint for GM 410 (Integrative Manager for Analytics) at Welingkar Institute (WeSchool). Covers strategic intent, Graham Kenny 3-step goal architecture, Porter's Five Forces and generic strategies, VRIO, TOWS, McKinsey 7S, BCG and GE-McKinsey portfolio matrices, Blue Ocean Strategy Canvas & ERRC, Big Data 5 Vs, Analytics Staircase, ML pipelines, Nimbus Bank capital allocation, Carroll's CSR Pyramid, Triple Bottom Line, Dunphy sustainability phases, Altman Z and Beneish M forensics, complete case dossiers for NVIDIA (including all 15 INSEAD teaching note poll keys), Microsoft, Amazon, and Coca-Cola, with 100% authentic model answers and marking rubrics for 2023, 2024, and 2025 university examinations.
